librqbit 9.1.0

License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-APACHE and NOTICE)

Kiwix's peer receive buffer checks frame readiness before borrowing
the decoded frame. Wrapped pieces still borrow both ring segments.
The engine denies unsafe code by default. Exceptions are the Windows
sparse-file system call and the optional memory-mapped storage example.
Kiwix does not select that example.
